title: SALT3: An Improved Type Ia Supernova Model for Measuring Cosmic Distances (Kenworthy et al. 2021)

episodes.description: Build and publish the SALT3.K21 SED model with SALTshaker from the K21 compilation (1083 SNe, 1207 spectra)

chain.op: compile JLA + Foundation + PS1 + DES + CfA4 + CSP + kaepora spectra
apply spectroscopic-class and light-curve coverage cuts
clean low-z spectra (clip host lines, mask telluric, drop noisy regions)
alternate Levenberg-Marquardt fit of flux-model and nuisance parameters
fit model-uncertainty parameters by likelihood with iMinuit
fit colour scatter with colour law free after convergence
estimate out-of-sample variance from Hessian and add to model uncertainty
validate on held-out half (K21train model on K21valid) via Hubble residuals
retrain on full K21 and compare distances/Hubble scatter to SALT2.JLA

episodes.description: Validate SALTshaker by training on a SNANA simulation of JLA with SALT2.JLA as truth

chain.op: simulate every JLA event with SNANA from best-fit z,t0,x1,c and cadence
compare synthetic photometry to truth model
compare distances on a large (~3000 SN) simulation

episodes.description: Fit one SN Ia light curve with a trained SALT model and convert to a distance modulus

chain.op: fit light curve with SNANA to obtain mB, x1, c
apply Tripp estimator for distance modulus
estimate nuisance parameters with SALT2mu in redshift bins
